main_text.p: נִגּוּר Ch. Protractio, Cælatura. Plur. const. בִּנְגּוּרִירְסְמָא Cum cælaturis argenteis, Prover.25.11. Resp. Hebr. מַשְׂכִּיּוֹרִין, unde probabile est Paraphrastem legisse per ש quasi esset a מָשַׁךְ quod trahendi significatio- nem habet,& per נִגַּר reddi solet.
נִגְרִין, נִגְרִין, נִגְרִין Chald. Fluvii, Fluenta, Flumina, Aquæductus, Processus aquarum: Item Clivi, Colles, Loca eminentia, prominentia, cùm respondet Hebraeo שְׁפָיִם.
נַגְרִין Syr. Plaga. Plur. נַגְרִין, נַגְרִין Plagæ, Verbera, Flagella.
מַגְרִין Syr. Flagellator, Tortor. Pl. נַגְרִין Tortoribus, Matth.18.34.
נֻגָּר Hebr. Coram, contra, è regione, ex adverso. Chald. נֻגַּר יְרוּשְׁלֵם Ex adverso Jerusalem, Dan.6.11.
נְגַהּ Syr. Splendere, Fulgere, Lucere, Illucescere. Item Morari, Tardare apud Talmudicos. Hinc Syr. in Aphel Pernoctabat in oratione, Luc.6.12.
נֻגְהָא, נְגַהָא Ch. Lux, Splendor: Item, Lucifer, Stella Veneris, Esth.10.3.
נְגוּתָא, נְגוּן Ch. Insulæ. Constr. נְגוּת.
נְגַח Chald. Cornupetere, Ferire. Pahel נְגַח Idem. Aphel אַגַּח, & אַגִּיחַ Idem: Item Proeliari, proelium, Bellum

page.notes: Pointed Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are rendered approximately; several vowel points and dagesh marks in the scan are doubtful. Faint show-through from the reverse page was ignored.
